verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense documents its own card program where every transaction is categorized (docs-9). It exposes transactions and budgets via the API (docs-2) and emits real-time S&E event notifications via webhooks (docs-3, docs-16), which points to same-day transaction capture rather than statement-based visibility. However, nothing documents a founder-facing real-time spend view broken down by team, category, and merchant. Missing for 10: an evidenced real-time spend dashboard or report, breakdowns by team/department and by merchant, explicit same-day transaction posting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
